newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Randstad reaches compromise in pay dispute.
newsitem.headline: Randstad reaches compromise in pay dispute.

text.p: Temporary employment agency Randstad NV said on Monday it had reached a compromise with the FNV Services Union in a dispute over the way in which Randstad pays part-time workers.
Randstad said it would disclose further details of the compromise on Tuesday.

Randstad's share price fell sharply last week after press reports said the FNV Services Union was pressing Randstad to pay part-time workers a gross fee rather than a net fee -- a move which the reports said could reduce Randstad's profit margins.

The reports said that under the net fee system, Randstad and other temporary employment agencies were able to pocket money that part-time workers could otherwise reclaim from the tax and social security authorities.
